meta.name: escalation-management
meta.description: Handles customer situations that have exceeded normal support — severity assessment, incident communication, executive escalation, and recovering a relationship after a failure. Use this when a customer issue is escalating or has gone to leadership, during a customer-affecting outage, when a major account is at risk, when a relationship needs repairing after a failure, or to design the escalation path itself.

copy.tagline: 应对客户升级全流程并修复关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户问题常超出常规支持范围,你需要快速判断并妥善沟通。
copy.tagline_en: Resolve escalated customer issues and repair the relationship.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle customer support and need a clear path from escalation to resolution.

howto.what: Claude 会按客户视角评估故障严重性，明确专人负责并保持定期沟通；先确认影响再解释原因，不轻易承诺。可为高管准备简报，指导修复关系，并在事后复盘升级原因。
howto.when: 当客户问题升级、发生影响客户的故障、重要账户有风险时触发；也可用于故障后修复关系或设计升级路径。

say.text: 客户投诉已经升级到领导层，帮我把这次升级按严重程度评估清楚。
say.note: Claude 会从客户损失角度评估，并给出沟通建议。

say.text: 我们正在经历影响客户的故障，请列出对外沟通的节奏和话术。
say.note: Claude 会安排固定节奏更新，避免客户失联。

say.text: 重要客户因故障要终止合作，帮我设计关系修复方案。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体致歉、防止再犯和补救行动。

howto.what_en: Claude assesses severity from the customer's perspective, keeps one visible owner and a set communication cadence, separates acknowledgment from explanation, avoids over-promising, briefs executives, guides recovery, and reviews what caused the escalation.
howto.when_en: Use when an issue is escalating, an outage affects customers, or a major account is at risk; also for relationship repair after failure or designing the escalation path.

say_en.text: A customer complaint has reached our leadership — help me assess severity clearly.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates impact from the customer's side and suggests communication.

say_en.text: We have an outage affecting customers; help me set an update cadence and messaging.
say_en.note: Claude will keep regular updates so the customer is never left uninformed.

say_en.text: A major account may leave after this failure; help me design a recovery plan.
say_en.note: Claude proposes specific acknowledgment, prevention, and repair actions.
